title: Pruning the Paradox: How CLIP’s Most Informative Heads Enhance Performance While Amplifying Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model predictions on the FairFace and SocialCounterFactuals datasets by passing neutral text prompts with 104 different occupations (e.g., "A photo of a <occupation>") and measuring the MaxSkew metric across racial groups, both before and after soft-pruning specific attention heads.

Evaluating model predictions on the FairFace and SocialCounterFactuals datasets by passing neutral text prompts with 104 different occupations (e.g., "A photo of a <occupation>") and measuring the MaxSkew metric across gender groups, both before and after soft-pruning specific attention heads.
